questDescription(installation==DMSAC_Graveyard)->Intercepted corps traffic points to an automatroid graveyard held by [siteFactionName]. Decommissioned machines are piled across the field, and scavengers have been stripping them for parts, so the corps posted a guard: (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).

Some of the hulks may still be recoverable, and the guard post keeps its supplies on site.

The position fix expires in [siteTimeout].

Caution: entering the graveyard counts as an attack on the corps. Once you arrive, its monitoring network will call in reinforcements after a countdown.

questDescription(installation==DMSAC_Garage)->A [siteFactionName] field maintenance base has been located. It services frontline units and moves with the task forces, so it will not stay put for long. It is defended by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat), and machines in for repair may be among them.

The workshop holds spare parts and stock for the units it maintains.

The base is expected to relocate in [siteTimeout].

Caution: entering the base counts as an attack on the corps. Once you arrive, its monitoring network will call in reinforcements after a countdown.

questDescription(installation==DMSAC_FacilityEnterance)->The surface shaft of a [siteFactionName] underground facility has been found. Military supplies are staged around the shaft, guarded by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).

The lift leads down into the facility itself. Its command core runs an alarm network and can lock the lifts once the alert is full.

The position fix expires in [siteTimeout].

Caution: entering the site counts as an attack on the corps. Once you arrive, its monitoring network will call in reinforcements after a countdown.

questDescription(installation==DMSAC_LogisticTerminal)->A [siteFactionName] logistic terminal has been located. It is an automated supply point where company-level squads rearm and drop off damaged machines, defended by turrets and a small guard of (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).

The terminal's stock is still on site.

The terminal's position holds for [siteTimeout].

Caution: entering the terminal counts as an attack on the corps. Once you arrive, its monitoring network will call in reinforcements after a countdown.

questDescription(installation==DMSAC_Checkpoint)->A [siteFactionName] checkpoint sits on a road nearby. It doubles as a transit station for the corps' patrols and is held by (*Threat)[enemiesCount] [enemiesLabel](/Threat).

The station keeps supplies for the patrols that pass through.

The checkpoint's position holds for [siteTimeout].

Caution: entering the checkpoint counts as an attack on the corps. Once you arrive, its monitoring network will call in reinforcements after a countdown.
